rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Cognethics provides an MCP server for enterprise workflow and field service management, enabling AI assistants to query work orders, invoices, and operational data. Access uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and is available through tenant-specific subdomains at customized endpoints. Supports retrieval and management of field service records for AI-driven automation.
